_comment: Owed dividends an operator ruled the broker will not credit (crucible_trader/dividend_entitlements.py, alpha-engine-config-I12024). Each waives ONE dividend by ticker, pay date and exact amount; an owed amount that differs by a cent is refused. A waived dividend leaves the owed list and is recorded in the reconciliation's `dividends_waived`. Store keys are relative to the crucible store prefix.

waivers.ruling: Brian 2026-11-09 (project thread, alpha-engine-config-I12024): waive the v1-era MU dividend the IB paper account never credited; ratified by the merge of this declaration.
evidence: corporate_actions/scans/2026-10-29.json (Polygon): MU cash dividend 0.15/share, ex and record 2026-10-14, pay 2026-10-29
trader/broker_statements/2026-10-13.json: MU 79 shares at the record session, so 79 x 0.15 = 11.85 was owed
trader/reconciliation/2026-10-29.json: cash_residual_usd -11.86, cash short exactly the MU dividend on its pay date

trader/reconciliation/2026-11-04.json: cash_residual_usd 107.69 is October interest (accrued_cash_usd fell 109.28 to 3.43 between trader/broker_statements/2026-11-03.json and 2026-11-04.json), leaving no room for the dividend
IB paper account did not credit
